description: Turn 3-8 headlines into a clean 1024x1024 shareable news image plus a one-line caption. Pure Python/Pillow rendering, no API key needed. $0.05 per image.

accent.description: Optional hex accent color, e.g. #1A73E8. Default #1A73E8.
accent.title: Accent color

brand.description: Optional footer brand, e.g. your outlet name. Default: 每日新闻 (zh) or Cashonly Daily (en).
brand.title: Brand / footer text

date.description: Date shown on the image, YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

headlines.description: 3-8 headlines. Each needs a title; source and summary are optional.

source.description: News source, e.g. Kyodo News. Max 40 characters.
source.title: Source

title.description: Headline text, max 60 characters (longer titles are truncated to fit).
title.title: Title

headlines.title: Headlines

input.title: Daily News Brief Image Generator input

name: daily-news-brief-image-generator

dataset.description: One item per generated image: date, language, headline count, image key, caption, 1024x1024 size, $0.05 price.
dataset.name: News brief images

keyValueStore.description: The generated 1024x1024 PNG, stored as news-YYYY-MM-DD.png.
keyValueStore.name: News brief PNGs

title: Daily News Brief Image Generator
